# Clarity Forward

> Clarity Forward helps business and nonprofit leaders see what's working, uncover friction, and decide what's next. Founded by Kate Kness in Arizona; serving clients across the United States.

## Ways to work together
- [The Clarity Snapshot](https://snapshot.theclarityforward.com/): complimentary, about three minutes. A look at clarity, systems, and independence.
- Snapshot Debrief ($195): a 45-minute conversation about your Snapshot results, with Your Next 3 priorities.
- Decision Session ($750): a 90-minute strategy session for one specific decision, problem, or next move.
- Clarity Health Check ($1,800): a guided, two-week look at how your organization actually works, with a written assessment organized into Keep, Fix, Focus, Delegate, and Stop.
- Fractional COO Support (custom): ongoing work that builds on a Clarity Health Check.
- Clarity Workshops (custom): for associations, networking groups, nonprofits, conferences, and leadership teams. Topics include key-person dependence, recurring friction, and prioritization.
